purpose: Reviewed project-owned device boundaries; original filesystem functions remain compiled and authoritative. These are not upstream runtime service bindings.

boundaries.name: osPfsIsPlug
boundaries.evidence: Caller800045FC moves its output pointer to a1; original800601A8 stores only one byte, and returns SI result. Mask bits identify any inserted accessory, including Rumble Pak.

boundaries.name: __osPfsGetStatus
boundaries.evidence: Original800608AC sets guest8009C434=FA to invalidate inode cache. Checks PIF status presence/change/communication and returns PFS codes1/2/4. Called by original InitPak80060550 after SI exclusion.

boundaries.name: __osContRamRead
boundaries.abi: a0=OSMesgQueue*, a1=s32 port, a2=u16 block, a3=u8[32]*
boundaries.evidence: Original builds read command2, performs SI write/read, copies exactly32 response bytes and checks data CRC; higher filesystem routines use block indices, not byte addresses.

boundaries.name: __osContRamWrite
boundaries.abi: a0=OSMesgQueue*, a1=s32 port, a2=u16 block, a3=u8[32]*; stack+10=s32 force
boundaries.evidence: Original protects blocks1..6 unless force==1, constructs write command3 and32 payload bytes, then checks returned data CRC. Original SelectBank80060A90 writes32 bank bytes to block400.
